resources.string: Track your daily activities directly from your home screen
Displays a developer\'s GitHub contribution grid and streak
Compare side-by-side streaks and contribution grids of two developers
LeetCode streak, today\'s status, solved counts, daily challenge and next contest. Syncs only when you tap SYNC or a reminder checks.
Claude, Gemini, Antigravity and Codex usage at a glance. Syncs only when you tap SYNC.
Start or stop a focus timer (plain or Pomodoro 25/5) for an hour-based activity. The time is added to today\'s progress when you stop.
Next Codeforces, AtCoder, CodeChef and LeetCode contests and your ratings. Syncs once a day or when you tap SYNC.
You vs up to 3 friends: problems solved today, streaks. Syncs when you tap SYNC.
One arXiv paper a day from your categories, with SAVE to your reading queue.
Your three must-dos for today with + buttons, plus calendar busy time.
Hours logged today vs time in distracting apps. Computed on the phone, no network.
The card that fits the moment: the running timer, this morning\'s Top 3, the next planned block, what\'s still open, or the evening shutdown.

Covers apps you marked distracting while a focus session runs, or pauses before they open. It only notices which app comes to the front; it never reads what is on the screen and nothing leaves your phone.
